item.title: Candlelight vigil mourns victims of ICE killings and violence in Minnesota
item.description: The vigil, organized by Indivisible Santa Barbara, took place to honor Alex Pretti and Renee Good after they were both fatally shot during interactions with immigration officials in Minneapolis. item.title: Santa Barbara teachers union pushes for 7th period at junior high schools; district says not a bargaining issue
item.description: English-language learners are deprived of taking an elective because they must take an English-support class. The Santa Barbara Teachers Association wants to give those students options.
